# Conditionally deliver three Arctic retained-source physical-region additions

Parent campaign: #1202. Required predecessor work: #1295 (completed narrow source-envelope approval and delivery handoff), #1261 (accepted original GSHHG custody/comparison), #1481/#1487 (exact seven-case Arctic source-fit packet and its PR delivery), and #1516 (integration-profile fix). This is one conditional engineering work item. It is not ready for claim until the required source packet and integration fix have actually merged and their delivered bytes have been read back.

## Purpose and decision boundary

Reuse the **actual accepted scope** of #1295: a named AAFC physical-region source-envelope fit, supported by the retained original GSHHG mapped-land overlay and exact no-loss geometry checks. The claim is limited to fit against those retained source references. AAFC is a generalized ecological reference, and GSHHG 2.3.7 is a dated, heterogeneous-observation physical source. Neither is treated as legal boundary authority or proof of current water/ice status.

The three existing Arctic proposals currently meet the measured source-fit predicates in the #1481 packet and have exact original GSHHG level-1 mapped-land support. #1295's target-specific approval does not transfer. Before any geometry edit, an independent reviewer must make a separate, candidate-specific applicability decision using the exact full source records and AAFC editions. Do not acquire, download, resample, simplify, or substitute another physical source to answer a question the retained evidence already addresses.

Only candidates receiving an actual independent PASS for the narrow retained-source fit may proceed to modification. A FAIL, mixed result, or unreviewed case remains unchanged and is recorded as unresolved with the exact failed premise. There is no batch-level approval by implication.

## Exact candidate scope

The only candidates eligible for this work item are:

The existing packet reports, for each listed case, unique containment in the same named AAFC region in both native and v2.2 editions, matching parent identity and retired-member context, an exact full-candidate union gain, zero target loss, zero candidate/gain symmetric difference, and no new positive-area intersection with an active neighbor. These are inputs to the independent gate, not approvals. The two AAFC editions differ geometrically; preserve each edition's result separately.

Retain all seven #1481 source cases and their complete original family/component context, as enumerated by the delivered source packet. Do not import an unrelated family count from #1295. The other four candidates remain unresolved and unchanged:

## Required independent applicability gate

Before editing any canonical or derived data, an independent reviewer must examine the exact current merged inputs and, for **each** candidate:

1. Authenticate the candidate geometry, target record, original full GSHHG record and decoded pointset by whole-file/member and record hashes. Reuse the accepted #1261 custody products; no new source acquisition.
2. Read the complete mapped-land, water, exterior, contradictory land/water, reconstruction, hierarchy-disagreement and outside-L1 result geometries from the retained operation. Confirm whether mapped-land support equals the whole candidate under the frozen method. Empty water-specific outputs are not evidence of water truth.
3. Independently reconcile the exact predicates accepted for the two #1295 corrections against this candidate's evidence. State explicitly whether a premise differs, or whether the only additional step is candidate-specific applicability approval. Do not import the #1295 approval itself.
4. Confirm unique named-envelope fit in native and v2.2 AAFC editions; current source identity and parent; complete retired-member context; exact no-loss/full-gain construction; only intended target contacts; and no new positive-area overlap against the complete affected active-neighbor universe.
5. Return one explicit PASS or FAIL decision per component under the same independently reviewed retained-source eligibility rule, with a short scope rationale, exact immutable source/proposal head and whole input pins. Post the independent applicability decisions on this issue and verify the complete posted body before editing geometry. This source decision does not require constructing a preliminary PR or running a PR-head review guard before the repair exists. The completed repair still requires the normal substantive independent exact-PR-head receipt and trusted guard before merge. No source approval count before the actual independent decisions are posted and read back.

If a candidate fails this gate, leave it unchanged, record the exact failed predicate and proceed only with candidates independently passed. If no candidates pass, preserve the packet, close this work item as review-only with no geometry change, and do not start downstream delivery.

## Conditional implementation and delivery

For each independently passed candidate only:

- Apply the exact recorded candidate geometry as a set-union addition to its existing canonical target. Preserve exact source coordinates; use no snapping, tolerance, buffer, repair, simplification, invented label, or inferred affiliation.
- Produce the complete source-attributed change receipt, old/new geographic footprints, exact union/loss/gain evidence, and whole affected-neighbor comparisons. Verify the complete active geography universe and preserve all unrelated geometries, IDs, names, parents and affiliations.
- Rebuild every affected prepared/offline release product and native-grid candidate using the existing reviewed construction and admission tools. Bind outputs to exactly the changed geography and release. Recompute content-addressed outputs and affected certificate scope; revalidate certificates through existing gates or explicitly invalidate them. Never present an old grid, release, or certificate as measured against changed footprints.
- Follow the actual accepted #1295 delivery handoff: one coherent core-geography PR and, only if derived/native outputs require it, one dependent derived-output PR (maximum two PRs total). Each PR receives exact-head independent substantive review, required normal checks, the serialized merge queue, exact merged-byte/mode/OID and main-pointer readback, and post-merge integration verification. Preserve any queue failure as terminal and use only the documented serialized recovery procedure.
- Complete normal issue/claim lifecycle: record independent gate receipts and delivery results, verify the merged work on current main, close only after acceptance, release the claim, preserve evidence, and remove only the managed checkout/resources owned by this work item.

If the current fixed-v8 restoration entry cannot select the successor products, update only the declared restoration entry/helper to bind the new reviewed bank while preserving the prior frozen bank and existing rejection guards. Do not let a subsequent repair silently restore stale v8 products or alter original scientific methods.

The parent #1202 remains context, not a prerequisite to closing this work. #1487 is the PR delivering predecessor issue #1481, not a separate issue dependency.

This work authorizes no live publication, deployment, production writer, legal boundary decision, or historical import.

## Source and interpretation limits to preserve verbatim in evidence

- GSHHG 2.3.7 was released 2017-06-15; observation dates are heterogeneous. Its candidate overlays support only a result relative to the retained source and frozen method.
- The source records classify as mapped-land support in the comparison output, while `water_status` remains `unverified` and physical authority remains `unapproved`. Do not reinterpret those fields as failed geometry or as new physical truth.
- The overlay does not settle narrow registration-sensitive shoreline/channel truth. Unrecorded river widths, seasonal wetness, observation-date mismatch, and source precision remain unmeasured.
- Native AAFC and v2.2 are distinct, generalized framework editions; native effective date is unknown. Their fit does not establish legal boundary authority, historic cause, current land/water/ice status, or publication approval.
- Retired administrative geometries are contextual cartographic references, not authority for the physical target or candidate.

## Acceptance

1. The issue is not made ready or claimed until #1481/#1487 and #1516 have actually completed their required merge, source readback and lifecycle, and the exact current inputs are available on main. Refresh and pin actual main bytes at claim time.
2. The independent applicability gate posts and reads back one explicit source-pinned decision per candidate under its common rule; only PASS cases enter implementation. Normal trusted exact-PR-head review is required for the finished repair before merge.
3. Each changed candidate has exact before/after proof, preserved full provenance, complete target/neighbor context, and zero target loss/new active-neighbor positive-area overlap.
4. Every required canonical, prepared, native, content and certificate output is regenerated or explicitly invalidated, admitted and bound to the delivered release; no stale output is represented as current.
5. Normal exact-head review, CI, serialized queue, post-merge readback/integration and issue/claim/checkout cleanup all pass. All failed attempts and declared limitations remain preserved.
6. No change is made for the four unresolved candidates or any other geography.

## Ordinary-build artifact consumption — human-authorized meta-system correction (2026-10-09)

This supersedes the requirement to replay all historical scientific validations and obtain their three original live brands on EVERY ordinary N2 application build.
